goal: one kernel call at a time, one transaction per document, thread affinity honoured
positive_oracle: Policy rảnh nhận call và transaction; policy thread-locked chỉ nhận đúng thread.
negative_oracle: Call chồng -> Busy; transaction chồng -> Busy; sai thread -> Permission.
decision_note: Mutex thật nằm ở session; policy là bản ghi kiểm tra được, không cấp phát.
method: Read the legacy OCCT adapter shells and the target crates. The portable adapter half (records, validation, handle lifetime, error contract, policy) is re-implemented in safe Rust; the native kernel boundary is not ported and is refused by name.
